summary: Osprey Acquisition Corp. III, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants beginning August 21, 2026. Units continue trading as OSPRU; shares and warrants will trade as OSPR and OSPRW on Nasdaq. Separation requires broker contact with Continental Stock Transfer Trust Company. This is a routine post-IPO administrative event, not a special situation. No substantive deal terms or strategic actions are involved; the announcement merely facilitates unit separation.
